newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi sees 1997 domestic production up.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi sees 1997 domestic production up.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp (MMC) said on Friday that it expected its domestic vehicle production to rise 1.0 percent from a year earlier to 1.25 million vehicles, after an expected 4.0 percent fall in 1996.
Japan's fourth-biggest carmaker said it expected domestic sales to rise 5.0 percent from a year earlier to 800,000 vehicles in 1997, after an expected 8.0 percent fall in 1996.
The company said that it forecast 1997 vehicle exports would rise 1.0 percent to 460,000, after an expected 10.0 percent fall this year.
Its overseas output will climb 12.0 percent to 830,000 in 1997 after an expected 5.0 percent increase this year, it said.
